description: For ONE operator (seller), find the ASINs where it's losing the buy-box — it carries the listing but holds less than `max_buybox_share_pct` of the buy-box — ranked by estimated 30-day revenue at risk. Each leak returns who's winning the box, the operator's vs the winner's sanitized price and the gap, how many sellers are on the listing, a `situation` (price_gap | tied_price | amazon_in_box | reseller_swarm), a `suggested_action` (reprice_to_win | enable_fba | defend_match_only | evaluate_or_exit), and a `suggested_target_price` when the box is winnable on price. Totals include the recoverable price-gap-only revenue. Use when the user asks 'where is seller X losing the buy-box', 'X's buy-box leaks', 'which ASINs should X reprice', 'where is X leaving money on the table', or 'what's X's revenue at risk'. Sortable by revenue-at-risk (default), price gap, buy-box share, or listing revenue.

exclude_amazon_in_box.description: Drop ASINs where Amazon holds the box (you can't win those).

fulfillment_in.description: Comma-separated operator fulfillment to keep (FBA, FBM).

limit.description: Leaks to return (default 25, max 100). This tool pages.

marketplace_id.description: 1 = Amazon UK, 2 = Amazon US (default), 4 = Amazon CA, 5 = Amazon AU, 6 = Amazon DE, 7 = Amazon JP, 8 = Amazon IT, 9 = Amazon FR, 10 = Amazon ES, 11 = Amazon MX, 12 = Amazon BR

max_buybox_share_pct.description: Only ASINs where the operator holds LESS than this share of the buy-box (0-1; default 0.75 — i.e. it's not dominating).

min_est_revenue_30d.description: Only ASINs with estimated 30-day listing revenue >= this.

min_price.description: Only ASINs whose listing price >= this (skip pennies).

situation_in.description: Comma-separated situations to keep (price_gap, tied_price, amazon_in_box, reseller_swarm).

sort.description: Sort the leaks: revenue_at_risk (default), price_gap_pct (biggest recoverable gap), buybox_share (lowest first), or listing_revenue.

name: operator_buybox_losses
